summary: Context-only committee read: the surface has shifted back to risk-on and the risk radar is calm/receding, with a measured 21-day pullback rate of 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. That de-escalates the earlier growth, internals, and bubble warnings, but it does not establish a fresh bullish confirmation: market_confirmed is false, no confirmation chip is fresh, breadth remains weak, and the global-breakdown leg remains elevated. The confirmed Q3 label is low-confidence and transitioning because its current axes read Q2. Cross-asset bonds/FX still diverge from the equity regime. Factor intelligence adds no active contradiction: Pair G is dormant because the panel has only 10 dates, the scorecard is explicitly survivorship-biased, and factor attention has zero graded firings. No ranked surface or trade posture was changed.
what_fired: World-state verdict returned to RISK_ON; radar moved from caution to calm and is receding.
Liquidity is supportive only as low-quality mechanical plumbing context; RRP is exhausted and there is no Fed asset-growth impulse.
Dealer gamma changed from short to long, while systematic flows remain split.
The confirmed regime label is Q3, but raw growth/inflation signs read Q2 and are only 1 of 7 sessions into confirmation.
Two confluence tensions remain: briefing demand-versus-supply divergences and bonds/FX versus the equity regime.
A causal hypothesis was staked only for forward testing: low-vol Fed net-liquidity deceleration preceding 21-day breadth deterioration.
contradictions_review: Primary contradiction: risk-on/calm surface versus weak internal participation—31.8% above the 50-day average, breadth divergence present, zero fresh market-confirmation chips, and global-breakdown intensity 86.8. Second: the low-confidence Q3 label conflicts with its own Q2-sign axes and with bonds/FX cross-asset confirmation. Options contradiction records are older (as of 2026-09-09) and therefore were not elevated. Factor Pair G has no records and cannot resolve the tension. Current contradictions also make the many overdue Master Brain theses unsafe to treat as live context; notably the Long Treasuries falsifier includes real 10-year yield above 2.5%, while the current reading is 2.68%.
decaying_families: Radar and several desk families have negative signed excess at 21–63 day horizons and remain unarmed; they should not be treated as authoritative directional engines.
Policy claims show negative signed excess across reported 5-, 21-, and 63-day windows and remain unarmed.
AI, stock, and thematic desk 63-day families are negative and their held-out tests are vacuous.
Factor composite, low-vol, low-beta, and investment legs have negative scorecard IC; the panel history floor is not met.
Master Brain open theses are administratively decayed: their check-by dates have passed while status remains open and unscored.

Watch whether weak breadth/global breakdown converges with the risk-on headline; use the pre-committed 45% breadth and global-intensity criteria, not discretion.
Score, close, or explicitly renew the overdue Master Brain theses. The Long Treasuries thesis deserves immediate review because its stated real-yield falsifier has been met.
